_meta.labeling_method: Architecture documentation + source reading. Labels created BEFORE seeing spectral output.

rationale.core: The central command/group/parameter machinery that everything else depends on.
rationale.decorators: Public API surface — @click.command, @click.option, etc. Wraps core.
rationale.parsing: Argument parsing (click.parser) and the exceptions it raises.
rationale.output: Terminal output: formatting, terminal UI (progress bars, prompts), and platform-specific implementations.
rationale.types: Parameter type system — all the concrete types (INT, STRING, Path, Choice, etc.).
rationale.internals: Internal utilities, compatibility shims, global state.
rationale.testing: Test runner (CliRunner) for testing Click applications.

notes: Click is a flat single-package library. All modules are click.*  so directory_partition produces a single group. Cross-directory recovery is not applicable (NaN). V-measure and boundary F1 are the relevant metrics here — they test whether spectral finds structure where directories provide none.
